main_text.l: Historia recentior est vel Orientalis, vel Occidentalis vel Australis.
Orientalis est vel Scythi-ca, vel Æthiopica vel Sinensis.
Scythica est vel Germani-ca, vel Hunnica, vel Slavoni-ca.
Germanica est vel Gothica, vel Francica, vel Anglo-Saxo-nica.
Gothica est vel Normanni-ca, vel Ost-Gothica, vel West-Gothica.

page.notes: The printed numerals in the left margin read as "I." and "(ı)"; the "(ı)" before "Germanica" is doubtful. The page number "28" is printed at top left. The catchword "Ca-" is at the lower right. The Scythi-/Germani- and Slavoni- hyphenations were read from the line ends. Right-edge fragments belong to the neighbouring page and are omitted.
